scope: F200 exact 2.0.77 localhost two-client browser personal-state continuity harness; native browser mouse and keyboard input execution is not established under the current Windows foreground policy; package-excluded evidence

target.network_scope: two exact localhost client processes connected to one loopback dedicated server

gui_structure.research_list: tags.mir_browser=research-list on the native list-box; selected_index is the rendered selected-subject indicator
gui_structure.selected_subject: tags.mir_browser=toggle-hide and tags.technology=<technology> proves that selected technology is rendered in native detail

player_outcome.queue: The hidden technology remains queued on the shared force.

boundaries.personal_view: The fixture observes per-player selected-subject visibility through the native research list and target detail tag; sparse, duplicate and unknown hidden payloads must leave that view unchanged, without claiming physical mouse or keyboard input.
boundaries.save_reload: The saved per-player views and the full active force snapshot are re-observed after a real server save/reload and two reconnects.
boundaries.configuration_change: Adding one exact inert local configuration marker triggers Factorio configuration change; the saved per-player views and full active force snapshot are re-observed.
boundaries.mod_removal: Literal MIR removal records owner interface, GUI presence and fixture-owned force/queue before/after disposition; it never claims that removed-mod GUI/storage is readable or rollback-capable.
boundaries.mod_readd: MIR re-addition opens a selected fixture technology and records observed native presentation only; it does not assert arbitrary restoration of removed-owner personal state.
boundaries.active_force_snapshot: All active force technologies exactly compare enabled, researched, level, visible_when_disabled and saved_progress, plus current research, progress and queue while MIR is active; literal MIR removal/re-add compares only fixture-owned technology/current/progress/queue facts because MIR-owned prototypes legitimately change.

results.selected_subject_visibility: The target is hidden for player A and visibly selected for player B through the native research list/detail contract; clearing player A then restoring its hidden input round-trips only player A.
results.malformed_hidden_rejection: Sparse, duplicate and unknown hidden payloads leave the prior selected-subject visibility and target detail caption unchanged.
results.active_full_force_snapshot_unchanged: True only for initial, save-reload and inert configuration-change phases after exact all-technology comparison.
results.fixture_owned_force_queue_unchanged: True only for MIR-active phases after exact fixture-owned technology/current/progress/queue comparison.
results.fixture_owned_force_queue_unchanged_duri: True only for literal MIR-removal and re-add phases after exact fixture-owned comparison; it is not a full active force snapshot claim.
